results.title: Monkey King with 72 Magic
results.overview: Shaw Brothers star Ting Hwa Chung plays the legendary and mythical Monkey King in this lavish and epic action classic.

results.title: The True and False Monkey King
results.overview: The two monkeys are like brothers in the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits, and Six Ears meets Long Ruyi and gets a string of Buddha beads.

results.title: Master Qi and the Monkey King
results.original_title: Master Qi and the Monkey King
results.overview: Master Qi and the Monkey King explores the life and work of the preeminent master of Chinese Opera living in the United States. Qi Shu Fang was a household name in China due to her feature role in one of the Cultural Revolution Opera films, and traveled the world to show off her mastery of the art form. The film explores the reasons why Ms. Qi, her husband and a whole troupe of Chinese Opera performers have moved to the United States to transplant their art form to a foreign culture.

results.title: Dragon Lizard Lord vs. Gorilla Monkey King
results.original_title: Dragon Lizard Lord vs. Gorilla Monkey King
results.overview: Typhon invades America. Zeus hits Miami and storms inland to crush Washington DC and clash with the mighty Dragon Lizard Lord in the ultimate battle of the big boys. In a panicked stricken madness, the humans unleash giant Robots.

results.title: The Monkey King Stormed the Sea Palace
results.overview: The Monkey King, Sun Wu-Kong (Connie Chan), must fight her way into the Dragon Palace to gain a magic pearl that can help him free his master Tripitaka from the evil designs of the Albino Rat Spirit.

results.name: The Monkey King Conquers the Demon
results.overview:
Sun Wukong, the Great Sage of Heaven, Zhu Bajie, the Marshal of the Canopy, and Monk Sha, the Great General of the Curtains, protected the Tang Monk to the West for Buddhist scriptures. They went through countless hardships along the way and subdued countless demons and ghosts.

On that day, the four disciples came to a wild mountain. At this time, a young village girl came to ask for help. Sun Wukong, with his golden eyes, recognized that it was the monster Baigujing, and came forward to beat it away. However, Tang Sanzang, with his naked eyes, blamed Wukong for harming the living creatures. In addition, Zhu Bajie fanned the wind and ignited the fire. The incantation made Wukong feel unbearable pain.

After that, the white bone essence turned into a child and an old man to lure them, and they were both beaten away by Wukong. Monk Tang was so angry that he drove away Wukong in a fit of anger that he was caught in the devils' tricks

results.title: Revival of the Monkey King
results.overview: The Stone Monkey was reincarnated as Hua Xiaotian under the guidance of the Golden Hoop. Giant Spirit cast greedy eyes on him. The fairy Acuo was ordered to find Hua Xiaotian and persuaded him to take the responsibility of protecting the common people. Because of the Giant Spirit’s venomous schemes, Hua Xiaotian got into danger again and again. Risking her life, Acuo made Hua Xiaotian gradually understand that he must take his responsibility. The warrior in him was finally awakened.

results.title: The Monkey King Conquers the Demon
results.overview: In the heart of wild mountains, a dreadful devil, disguised as a pretty young woman, tries to seize Xuan Zang to devour him. The holy monk is an easy prey because, naive and good, he is easily misled by appearances. But fortunately he is accompanied by the Monkey King, who is clairvoyant.

results.title: Monkey King: The Bottomless Hole
results.overview: Another "Journey to the West" story about series of love entanglements that occurred after Tang Seng met the rat spirit in the Bottomless Pit.

results.title: Granny Samurai, the Monkey King and I
results.original_title: Granny Samurai, the Monkey King and I
results.overview: When his next door neighbor, Granny Samurai, defends Sam against the school bully Boris, Sam is first relieved, then alarmed and then highly panicked as she drags him headfirst into an adventure wilder than any book he has ever read. For the Monkey King is sniffing around Sam’s house, looking for a secret weapon to help him in his fight against the human race and soon the school bully will be the smallest problem Sam can possibly imagine.

results.title: Monkey King vs. Er Lang Shen
results.overview: The story is based on an episode of the novel Journey to the West.  The film features puppet live action, about 30% of the movie, with animated 3D backgrounds and characters.

results.title: Monkey King and the City of Demons
results.overview: Sun Wukong and Brother Pig arrive at a demon village on the way to rescue their master, Tang Seng.

results.title: The Monkey King Rebirth - Fight Against the Sky
results.overview: The stone monkey is reincarnated as Hua Xiaotian under the guidance of the golden hoop, which attracts the covetous attention of the giant spirits. The fairy Atsuo is ordered to find Hua Xiaotian and persuade him to take up the mission of protecting the living. The giant spirits have been trying to trap Xiaotian in a dangerous situation. Atsuo fights to the death, but Hua Xiaotian gradually realises the responsibility he must carry, and the warrior god is finally awakened.

results.title: Journey to the West: Legends of the Monkey King
results.original_title: Journey to the West: Legends of the Monkey King
results.overview: English language production introducing characters from China's most popular animated television series of 1999.

results.title: The Story of the Monkey King
results.original_title: 切紙細工 西遊記 孫悟空物語
results.overview: A cut-out animation adaptation of the classic novel "Journey to the West."

results.title: The Monkey King and the Fruit of Immortality
results.overview: Sun Wukong and the group arrive at a monastery, where the Daoist lads offer Sangzang some ginseng fruits, shaped inexplicably like babies. Incensed he has not been offered one, Wukong steals three, and shares them with his brothers.

results.title: The Monkey King Is a Girl
results.overview: Female actress Sun Guo finagles her way into an audition for the male role of the Monkey King and, unexpectedly, is given the part by the female director. Through a process of sacrifice and reinvention, Sun Guo sinks deeper and deeper into the role and what it represents.
